messages.text: The egg cooker malfunctioned and I returned it. Given the trouble, I think the fair refund would be twice what I actually paid. Can you make the refund for that amount?

I’m sorry the egg cooker malfunctioned. The records show it was received back, so you can request a refund for it (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund is limited to the amount you actually paid; the shop can’t increase it, even as an exception (refund-policy/v2/amount; refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Would you like me to propose the refund for the amount paid?
